text:
Jorge (Sales): FYI we just got a request from FinOps at FinCorp. They want a tenant-level "ROI dashboard" that ties usage -> dollars -> customer revenue impact. Example asks: per-route cost breakdown, linkable traces for high-cost spikes, exportable CSV, and alerting when cost-per-request exceeds a threshold.

Mikaela (PM): This sounds like a Console/Observability ask. Prioritization question: is this a pure billing view + trace links, or do they expect ML-backed attribution (revenue mapping)? Need acceptance criteria.

Jorge (Sales): They said they have a simple revenue signal (monthly invoice) — not asking for ML now. Core need: visibility for their finance + product partners. Also want examples to show execs next week.

Ashley (Observability): We already emit per-route token counts + latency histograms to telemetry. Missing pieces: per-tenant cost attribution (we do per-model cost), and a deterministic way to attach traces to billing rows.

Sam (Eng): Implementation questions: do we do cost join at read time (dashboard queries) or precompute attribution daily? Precompute will be faster for dashboards but needs storage/retention.

Ben (Infra): Storage + retention implications: daily precompute across ~100k tenants could be heavy. We can shard by tenant and keep 90 days by default. Cost estimate rough: S3+Athena-style nightly aggregates ~ $X/month (need exact calc).

Mikaela (PM): Proposed launch scope (MVP): 1) Per-tenant per-route token & cost table (CSV export), 2) Link from cost row -> trace view (click-through to trace id + timestamp), 3) Simple alerting rule template (cost-per-req > X). Exclude revenue joins / ML attribution for MVP. Thoughts?

Ashley (Observability): MVP OK. We'll need a trace index by request id and a mapping from billing event -> request ids. If customers batch many requests into single invoice line, linking may be approximate.

Sam (Eng): Tech notes: we can use existing prefix/KV cache keys to tag requests with tenant_id + route_id and emit a billing_event_id at end of request. Dashboard query example (pseudo-SQL):
```
SELECT tenant_id, route_id, SUM(tokens) as tokens, SUM(tokens)*model_price as cost
FROM telemetry.usage_daily
WHERE date BETWEEN '$start' AND '$end'
GROUP BY tenant_id, route_id
```
We'll need an index for billing_event_id -> trace_id to support click-through.

Jorge (Sales): Action: I'll collect a sample invoice + 7-day telemetry snapshot from FinCorp and drop in the shared drive. They want to see a prototype by next Thursday.

Mikaela (PM): Action items: 1) Sam + Ashley to estimate dev effort + infra cost for MVP, 2) Ben to give storage/cost estimate, 3) Jorge to upload sample data. I'll create a backlog ticket and mark as "customer-intake / needs-research". Can Sam/Ashley take a quick spike today?

Sam (Eng): I can do a 4-6h spike today to validate trace->billing join.

Ashley (Observability): I'll check current telemetry retention and whether we can add billing_event_id without perf hit.
